glosses: original (relating to the origin or beginning)
original (being the first in a series)

examples.text: Isso é parte do plano original?
examples.en: Is that part of the original plan?
Tom has a lot of original ideas.

examples.text: O que você acha do plano original?

examples.text: Essa cópia está diferente do original.
examples.en: That copy differs from the original.
